lyrics:
[Intro: bouncy funk guitar, bubbly synth bass, a can opening]

[Verse 1: deadpan, breathy, light beat]
Oh, he's rearranged his week
Learned my coffee, learned my street
Told his mother, told his priest
I said hi, at least

[Pre-Chorus: claps, voice sweetens]
I can't relate to wanting more
I'm what the wanting's for

[Chorus: full disco-funk groove, stacked harmonies]
I'm a main character energy drink
One sip and he forgets how to think
Zero sugar, a hundred per cent
Side effects include commitment
Is it me? It's me, it's the fizz
Limited edition, and it is what it is

[Verse 2: deadpan, quicker]
I can't talk, I've got a thing (it's a nap)
He sent flowers, sent a ring (sent it back)
Said I'm cruel, I said I'm booked
He said "please," I said "look"

[Pre-Chorus: claps, voice sweetens]
I can't relate to wanting more
I'm what the wanting's for

[Chorus: full disco-funk groove, stacked harmonies]
I'm a main character energy drink
One sip and he forgets how to think
Zero sugar, a hundred per cent
Side effects include commitment
Is it me? It's me, it's the fizz
Limited edition, and it is what it is

[Bridge: beat thins, spoken-sung like a label being read]
Shake well
Serve cold
Do not operate heavy machinery
Keep out of reach of exes

[Final Chorus: everything, ad-libs, extra guitar]
I'm a main character energy drink
One sip and he forgets how to think
Zero sugar, a hundred per cent
Side effects include commitment
Is it me? It's me, it's the fizz
Limited edition, and it is what it is

[Outro: guitar lick, a sip, a satisfied sigh]
Mm. That's me.
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 104 BPM, 4/4, C major. A bouncy, sunny, mid-tempo disco-funk strut. Light as a feather.

VOICE: Female, bright and sweet with a breathy top and a completely deadpan delivery. She never oversells a joke. The chorus is stacked in tight, airy harmonies. The bracketed asides are muttered. The bridge is half spoken, like reading a label.

INSTRUMENTS: A clean, choppy funk guitar. A bubbly, bouncing synth bass. A crisp disco drum beat with a tight hi-hat. Handclaps. Glossy synth chords. A little string swell into each chorus. Sound effects: a can opening, a sip.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro, funk guitar, bass and a can opening. 0:09 Verse 1. 0:27 Pre-chorus. 0:36 Chorus 1. 0:59 Verse 2. 1:17 Pre-chorus. 1:26 Chorus 2. 1:49 Bridge, the label read aloud. 2:07 Final chorus with ad-libs. 2:30 The groove rides with a guitar lick. 2:45 Outro, a sip, a sigh and three words at 2:52.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-2020s retro-funk pop: glossy, bright and airy, tight low end, vocals very close and lightly doubled.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The first chorus line, delivered without a smile.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The joke borrows the language of wellness cans and warning labels. Sung by someone older it becomes a statement about no longer shrinking, and the asides ('it's a nap') are honest about energy levels.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Amusement, more amusement, a wink.
